title: Between Myths and Metaphors: Rethinking LLMs for SRH in Conservative Contexts
reasoning: The paper includes a component evaluating how LLMs handle religious framing and folk beliefs (referred to as myths) within the cultural and healthcare context of Pakistan. Specifically, Section 4.13.4 'Religious Framing' analyzes the integration of religious language in model outputs as a metric for cultural sensitivity and trust-building.
